# What is this wRVU offer really worth?

> Free physician wRVU compensation calculator. Compare base-plus-productivity, pure wRVU and fixed salary, find the break-even wRVUs, effective $/wRVU, pay per hour, shortfall exposure and signing-bonus clawback, and compare two offers. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
